title: Luke’s Back
caption: Luke’s Back (V)
game_text: Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) Luke’s Blaster Pistol, Luke’s Lightsaber, or non-Jedi Luke. OR Unless Inner Strength on table, use 1 Force to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny targeting Luke (or a just drawn duel or lightsaber combat destiny if Luke is participating).
